submitted.rationale: XRD showed Ag metal (Q≈2.67, 3.09) plus an Ag–Sb oxide phase on the Ag-rich side, and Sb6O13-type pyrochlore (Q≈2.12, 2.45, 3.46, 4.06) growing toward the Sb-rich end. EQE at 2.1 eV rose sharply toward Ag-rich compositions: idx16 ≈ 0 %, idx5 = 0.064 %, idx2 = 1.03 %. Idx2 (Ag0.62Sb0.38) is the best measured point.

rejected.reason: Wide-gap antimony-oxide phases don't absorb at 2.1 eV; trend shows decreasing EQE with Sb
